title: [Bug] 'Your Privacy' onboarding card does not mention automatic telemetery enabled
body:
In the onboarding card 'Your Privacy', there is no mention that telemetry is enabled by default (see screenshot below).

### Expected behavior
 - Mention that telemetry is enabled **[Vesta] and how to disable it**
 - (nice-to-have) A toggle switch to disable it in onboarding? ### [Vesta] might be too many options in onboarding

### Actual behavior
 - No mention of telemetry enabled.

### Device information

* Android device: n/a
* Fenix version: 27/06/19

![Screenshot_20190711-131508](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1370580/61071973-570d4500-a3e0-11e9-9194-e09cf05777b9.png)

┆Issue is synchronized with this [Jira Task](https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FNXV2-12329)
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: @mheubusch @apbitner  can we have strings and updated designs for this?

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: The onboarding card was approved by legal. The issue is that the data collection settings should be updated to reflect the same language in the privacy notice - that Usage and technical data is collected by default. Note that the label for the section is Data collection (not choices) and the telemetry collection is called Usage and technical data

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: @vesta0 please move into dev if you approve the previously designed solution.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: FYI: I've added a screenshot into the issue to ensure we're referring to the same thing.

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: @mheubusch the proposed changes does provide more clarification. If you and Legal both approved onboarding then we can close this issue.
